findings.title: read_file joins a caller path onto the root
findings.description: read_file in reader.py joins the caller's path onto the root without a containment check.
findings.impact: A caller who controls the path can read files outside the root.
findings.exploit_scenario: A caller passes ../ segments as the path.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it stays under the root.
preconditions: The caller controls the path argument.
